open_points.subject: capture eligibility after a run ends
open_points.text: State 0 says capture is refused for “an execution that succeeded, was skipped, belongs to another contract version, or whose run was already released”; A15 and State 4 instead say it is allowed only when “the run has not ended, or ended `failed` and was not released” and refused otherwise.
open_points.question: May a failed function execution be captured after its run ended `succeeded`, `refused`, or `cancelled`, particularly when the captured inputs contain no files, or must every such capture be refused?
options: Refuse capture after every final status except an unreleased `failed` run, as A15 and State 4 state.
Permit capture after other final statuses when all required inputs remain available, treating State 0's listed failures as exhaustive.
Refuse only released runs, even though file inputs may already have been removed after other final statuses.
open_points.default_guess: Follow the later, more specific A15 and State 4 rule: refuse capture after any final status other than an unreleased `failed` run.
